{
  "id": "PUB016",
  "title": "Flexible Processing Control",
  "difficulty": "hard",
  "requirements": "# Flexible Processing Control\n\n- **Difficulty:** Hard (hard)\n\n## Requirements\n\nAn automated production line consists of 5 workstations: numbered 1# to 5# from left to right. The 1# station is used for raw material loading, stations 2# to 4# are used for product processing, and the 5# station is used for finished product output and storage.\nThere is a motor in the production line, responsible for moving the product from one workstation to the next. Each workstation has a sensor (used to detect if the product has arrived).\nEach product has a different sequence and number of processing steps, specified by the process sequence 'processSequence'. The processSequence is an array type, storing the sequence numbers of the workstations, and the system automatically sends the raw materials to the corresponding workstation for processing based on the station number.\nControl requirements:\nAt the start of production, when the sensor at the 1# station (sensor1) detects the raw material, the start button at the 1# station (station1Start) is pressed. The system queries the first element of the process sequence 'processSequence', starts the conveyor to move the raw material to the corresponding workstation, and stops after delivery. Upon receiving the processing completion signal from the corresponding workstation (station2Complete to station4Complete), it continues to query the next element of the process sequence 'processSequence', determines the direction of the conveyor, and starts the conveyor (conveyorLeft, conveyorRight). This continues until the product is delivered to the 5# workstation.\n\nprocessLength specifies the active sequence length, from 1 through 8, starting at processSequence[1]. The final active entry is output station 5; other active entries are processing stations 2 through 4. The caller supplies a sequence satisfying this contract.\n\n## Interface Definition\n\n| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Input | `processLength` | `USINT` | Active process-sequence length, 1..8; the final active entry must be station 5. |\n| Input | `sensor1` | `BOOL` | Sensor at 1# station |\n| Input | `sensor2` | `BOOL` | Sensor at 2# station |\n| Input | `sensor3` | `BOOL` | Sensor at 3# station |\n| Input | `sensor4` | `BOOL` | Sensor at 4# station |\n| Input | `sensor5` | `BOOL` | Sensor at 5# station |\n| Input | `station1Start` | `BOOL` | Start button at 1# station |\n| Input | `station2Complete` | `BOOL` | Processing completion signal at 2# station |\n| Input | `station3Complete` | `BOOL` | Processing completion signal at 3# station |\n| Input | `station4Complete` | `BOOL` | Processing completion signal at 4# station |\n| Input | `processSequence` | `ARRAY[1..8] OF USINT` | Processing sequence |\n| Output | `conveyorLeft` | `BOOL` | Conveyor turns left |\n| Output | `conveyorRight` | `BOOL` | Conveyor turns right |",
  "scenario": "A bidirectional conveyor follows a bounded sequence that may revisit processing stations.",
  "interface": [

  "initial_conditions": {
    "conveyorLeft": false,
    "conveyorRight": false,
    "phase": "IDLE",
    "currentStation": 1,

  },
  "scan_semantics": "Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Left and right are mutually exclusive.",
    "Target arrival stops motion before accepting processing completion."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The active sequence satisfies the official contract and remains fixed throughout a product cycle.",
    "station1Start is a rising edge accepted with sensor1 while idle.",
    "Destination arrival immediately stops the motor. Completion is accepted only at the current processing wait.",
    "Completion signals are rising edges. Consecutive equal stations denote separate processing operations with fresh edges and no conveyor movement.",
    "Only one sequence-index advancement occurs per invocation. Station5 arrival returns to idle.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "Station completion edges are ignored unless post-entry phase is WAIT_PROCESS; dropping a station arrival sensor while already in WAIT_PROCESS is outside caller error injection.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "left": "conveyorLeft",
    "right": "conveyorRight",
    "higher": "post-phase MOVING AND targetStation>currentStation AND NOT sensor[targetStation]",
    "lower": "post-phase MOVING AND targetStation<currentStation AND NOT sensor[targetStation]",
    "arrive": "pre-phase MOVING AND sensor[targetStation]",
    "stop": "NOT conveyorLeft AND NOT conveyorRight",
    "waiting": "pre-phase WAIT_PROCESS AND no fresh completion edge",
    "out": "pre-phase MOVING AND targetStation=5 AND sensor5",
    "done": "post phase IDLE after station5 arrival",
    "moving": "pre-phase MOVING",
    "processing": "pre-phase WAIT_PROCESS",
    "completion": "fresh matching processing-complete edge in the current wait",
    "started": "station1Start rising edge accepted with sensor1 in idle",
    "processLength": "I[k].processLength: sampled input (USINT).",
    "sensor1": "I[k].sensor1: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "sensor2": "I[k].sensor2: sampled input (BOOL).",

    "station2Complete": "I[k].station2Complete: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "station3Complete": "I[k].station3Complete: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "station4Complete": "I[k].station4Complete: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "processSequence": "I[k].processSequence: sampled input (ARRAY[1..8] OF USINT).",
    "conveyorLeft": "O[k].conveyorLeft: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "conveyorRight": "O[k].conveyorRight: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "station1Start_rejected": "pre-phase IDLE AND station1Start AND NOT sensor1",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: Spre.phase=\"IDLE\", O_init.conveyorLeft=false, O_init.conveyorRight=false."
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "PUB016.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB016.P1",
      "name": "Interlock",
      "formula": "G(!(left & right))",
      "explanation": "Both directions can never run together.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB016.P2",
      "name": "Direction",
      "formula": "G((higher -> (right & !left)) & (lower -> (left & !right)))",
      "explanation": "The target/current station order determines direction.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB016.P3",
      "name": "Arrival",
      "formula": "G(arrive -> stop)",
      "explanation": "Every destination stops movement immediately.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB016.P4",
      "name": "Wait",
      "formula": "G(waiting -> stop)",
      "explanation": "A processing wait does not move without completion.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB016.P5",
      "name": "Output",
      "formula": "G(out -> (done & stop))",
      "explanation": "The final station completes the sequence.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB016.P6",
      "name": "Conditional completion",
      "formula": "(G(moving -> F arrive) & G(processing -> F completion)) -> G(started -> F done)",
      "explanation": "Under the valid fixed-sequence input contract, eventual external feedback permits every started route to complete.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB016.P7",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "G(station1Start_rejected -> stop)",
      "description": "Pressing station1Start in IDLE when sensor1 is FALSE keeps both conveyor motors OFF.",
      "explanation": "Forbids starting automatic transport without a detected product at station 1.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}

ARCHITECTURAL PLAN:
{
  "state_machine": [
    {
      "state": "IDLE",
      "transitions": [
        "On a station1Start rising edge with sensor1 true, validate and snapshot the active recipe, set currentStation=1 and sequenceIndex=1, then select the first target.",
        "If recipe validation fails, enter FAULT. Otherwise apply target selection immediately.",
        "Ignore start edges when sensor1 is false or outside IDLE."
      ]
    },
    {
      "state": "MOVING",
      "transitions": [
        "Keep currentStation as the departure station and drive toward target until sensor[target] is true.",
        "On target arrival, stop in the same scan and set currentStation=target.",
        "If target=5, enter IDLE. Otherwise enter WAIT_PROCESS; a fresh matching completion edge on this arrival scan is accepted into DEFER."
      ]
    },
    {
      "state": "WAIT_PROCESS",
      "transitions": [
        "Keep both directions off until a fresh rising edge of the completion input matching currentStation.",
        "On completion, increment sequenceIndex once and select the next target.",
        "If the next target equals currentStation, remain in WAIT_PROCESS for a separate operation; do not reuse the consumed edge."
      ]
    },
    {
      "state": "DEFER",
      "transitions": [
        "This stopped state represents a completion accepted on an arrival scan. On the next invocation, increment sequenceIndex once and select the next target.",
        "If selection immediately arrives at another processing station and its fresh completion edge is present, accept it and remain in DEFER."
      ]
    },
    {
      "state": "FAULT",
      "transitions": [
        "Keep both directions off. Reinitialization is required to clear the fault; no reset input is specified."
      ]
    },
    {
      "state": "target_selection",
      "transitions": [
        "Check index bounds before accessing the snapshot. For a different target, enter MOVING unless its sensor is already true; if true, process arrival immediately and keep motion off.",
        "For an equal processing target, enter a fresh WAIT_PROCESS without moving or reusing the completion edge that selected it.",
        "Accept a fresh matching completion on a processing arrival into DEFER, including when selection and arrival occur in the same invocation.",
        "Perform no more than one sequence-index advancement per invocation. DEFER separates an arrival-scan completion from its subsequent advancement."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "timer_plan": {
    "timers": [],
    "note": "No timer is required by the specification. The unconditional top-level timer-call stage remains present but has no calls."
  },
  "priorities": [
    "Initialize outputs off; enforce mutual exclusion by unified direction assignments.",
    "Invalid recipe or invalid internal state enters FAULT with outputs off. There is no runtime reset or emergency-stop port in the interface.",
    "Arrival stops motion in the same scan, including when a completion edge is also accepted.",
    "Sample completion edges globally, but accept them only for the processing wait currently being entered or occupied. Do not reuse an edge for a subsequent operation.",
    "Advance the sequence index at most once per invocation; a completion accepted on arrival is deferred.",
    "Recipe validity is guaranteed by the caller and the active recipe remains fixed throughout the cycle."
  ],
  "initial_values": {
    "phase": "IDLE",
    "currentStation": 1,
    "sequenceIndex": 0,
    "target": 1,
    "conveyorLeft": false,
    "conveyorRight": false,
    "previous_station1Start": false,
    "previous_station2Complete": false,
    "previous_station3Complete": false,
    "previous_station4Complete": false,
    "snapshotLength": 0,
    "snapshotSequence": [
      0,
      0,
      0,
      0,
      0,
      0,
      0,
      0
    ]
  },
  "scan_execution_order": [
    {
      "stage": 1,
      "name": "edge sampling",
      "action": "Sample all inputs and compute rising edges for station1Start and station2Complete through station4Complete. Update their retained previous values every invocation, regardless of phase."
    },
    {
      "stage": 2,
      "name": "safety/reset priority and state transitions",
      "action": "Apply fault and bounds checks, then perform the state transitions and immediate target-arrival handling. Validate the snapshot as length 1..8, final entry 5, and preceding active entries 2..4. There is no reset input. Track the one-advancement limit and preserve arrival-scan completions in DEFER."
    },
    {
      "stage": 3,
      "name": "unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF",
      "action": "No timer FB calls are needed."
    },
    {
      "stage": 4,
      "name": "unified output assignments",
      "action": "Assign conveyorRight true only when the post-transition phase is MOVING, target>currentStation, and sensor[target] is false. Assign conveyorLeft true only when the post-transition phase is MOVING, target<currentStation, and sensor[target] is false. Otherwise assign both false."
    }
  ],
  "formal_assertions": [
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "formula": "G(!(conveyorLeft && conveyorRight))"
    }
  ]
}

CODESYS DIALECT CARDS:
[
  {
    "id": "ton_timer",
    "title": "Standard IEC TON Timer Block Invocation",
    "body": "// Standard IEC TON timer: MUST invoke unconditionally OUTSIDE CASE/IF every scan!\nVAR\n    timer : TON;\n    runTimer : BOOL;\nEND_VAR\n// Control via boolean IN flag (never put timer(...) only inside an IF/CASE arm):\nrunTimer := (state = 1) AND NOT resetCmd;\ntimer(IN := runTimer, PT := T#2s);\nIF timer.Q THEN\n    // Timer expired; timer.ET holds elapsed time\nEND_IF;"
  },
  {
    "id": "case_state_machine",
    "title": "Explicit CASE State Machine Transitions",
    "body": "// 4-Stage Scan Order: 1) Edge sample 2) Reset/priority & CASE state transition\n// 3) Unconditional top-level TON/R_TRIG calls 4) Unified output assignments\nVAR\n    state : INT := 0; // 0=IDLE, 1=RUN, 2=FAULT\nEND_VAR\nIF emergencyStop THEN state := 2; END_IF;\nCASE state OF\n    0: IF startCmd AND NOT fault THEN state := 1; END_IF;\n    1: IF faultCmd THEN state := 2; ELSIF stopCmd THEN state := 0; END_IF;\n    2: IF resetCmd THEN state := 0; END_IF;\n    ELSE state := 0;\nEND_CASE;\noutActive := (state = 1); // Assign outputs unconditionally from current state"
  }
]
